The 3,024th Annual Council invites papers on the disposal of systemically important magical assets. This year's theme is **credible commitment**: how does a coalition bind itself to destroying an asset that makes its holder progressively less willing to destroy it?

**Submission notes:**

- Extended abstracts (max 2 pages) by 30 September to the Last Homely House, attention: reception desk.
- The programme committee regrets that "just give it to the eagles" papers will be desk-rejected. Again.
- Travel grants available for parties of nine or fewer.
- Accommodation is provided; the catering is elvish, so eat before you come if you like chips.
